Iron
Iron deﬁciency anemia is a common form of anemia in IBD patients with active disease and can be caused by blood loss from
mucosal inﬂammation, malnutrition with reduced iron intake or impaired uptake through the duodeno-jejunal mucosa (Dingnass
et al., 2015). It should be screened for at least every 3-months with a ferritin level during periods of active disease (Bischoff et al.,
